title: Yerevan - Oct 16,  On the sidelines of the Summit of the 17th Conference of the Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity, Iran’s Foreign Minister made remarks
text:
Yerevan - Oct 16,  On the sidelines of the Summit of the 17th Conference of the Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity, Iran’s Foreign Minister made remarks"

"SOT, Abbas Araghchi (Farsi): “At the international level, this is now a very important issue. We cooperate closely with the Environmental Organization in this regard, particularly on the environmental effects of war, one of the key issues we are pursuing. In the President’s [Pezeshkian] speech today, you also noted that he referred to the environmental consequences for the region of the wars the United States has imposed on it. This issue is on our agenda, and we will pursue it.”
